description: Get a structured decision about the facts in state: yes or no with a probability, one of several choices, or a score, from rules you send or from a model. Without model, or with model rules, each rule is {"if": condition, "weight": number}, where a condition tests a field of state with eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, exists, prefix or contains, combined with any and not, and yes_no, choice and scale questions answer with probability, confidence and action. With model clef, nimble or tev1, a model answers noul, choice and score questions from instructions and criteria, with no automatic action or rule trace; tev1 is the smallest and fastest, tested by its maker in English only, for short, direct questions. Model requests take up to 8 KiB of JSON, 3 KiB for tev1, 4 questions and 8 choices per question, within 60 per minute and 1000 per UTC day per IP; refusals may carry Retry-After. Bodies are not stored; usage counters are. Do not send credentials or sensitive personal data. Format: https://aisense.no/free-public-api-decide-api-endpoint. No API key, no account and no sign up.

model.description: Optional. rules (default), clef, nimble or tev1. Unknown models are refused.

questions.description: 1 to 64 named rule questions, or up to 4 model questions under the default model limits.

state.description: The facts the rules test, or the input sent to the selected model.

name: decide
title: Decide from rules or a model
